description: Browse Swagger/OpenAPI from an editor sidebar tree and Swagger UI. Auto-discovers the real spec even from a UI URL. Supports corporate proxy, private CA, and token auth.
welcome:
You have not added any APIs yet.
[Add API](command:swaggerViewer.addApi)
You can add a spec URL or a Swagger UI page address (e.g. .../api-docs).
config.url: Legacy single API URL. Still shown in the tree next to `swaggerViewer.specs`; use **Add API** to register more.
config.specs: Registered APIs (gateways/services). Managed from the OpenAPI view: ＋ / right-click **Add API**, **Rename**, **Edit URL**, **Remove API**. e.g. `[{ "name": "Gateway", "url": "https://api.example.com/api-docs" }]`.
config.specs.name: Display name
config.headers: Extra HTTP headers sent when fetching the spec. e.g. `{ "X-Api-Key": "..." }`. For tokens, prefer the `Swagger: Set Auth Token` command (SecretStorage).
config.strictSSL: Whether to verify TLS certificates. Set false only for corporate private-certificate environments.
config.caCertPath: Path to a corporate private CA certificate (PEM). When set, verification uses this CA.
config.proxy: Proxy URL. When empty, uses VS Code's http.proxy setting or the HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY environment variable.
